finding: October 22 is an approximate onset reported later by Kenyan authorities and UNHCR; do not equate observation date with contemporary discovery on Oct 22.

UNHCR says local authorities estimate up to 50,000 crossed since October 22; registration incomplete. Agency announces relief response and appeal of $8.9m for support up to 50,000. This is lagging/confirmatory behavior, not a leading forecast.

event_title: Kenyan police announce border security measures
finding: Kenya police inspector general described security deployment and protection for Moyale/Marsabit after displacement; response to existing crisis rather than prediction of a new interstate offensive.
